Your Own AI Course

Your institution's AI course, not ours

A complete asynchronous AI course in your branding, built around your own AI and data policies, delivered to your LMS and licensed for every member of staff.

What this service covers

Most universities already have an AI policy. Far fewer have a way of getting it in front of staff in a form anyone will sit through.

This service closes that gap. We build a single asynchronous course that carries your branding, references your own policies by name, and uses examples drawn from the work your staff actually do. You receive it as a SCORM or xAPI package, load it into your existing LMS, and it looks and behaves like something your institution made.

Your course is built around:

  • your visual identity, including colours, fonts, and logo
  • your AI policy, acceptable use guidance, and data protection position
  • the tools your staff are licensed to use, whether that is Copilot, Gemini, ChatGPT, or a combination
  • the roles and workflows that matter most to you

We are an HE-specialist training provider, not a course factory. The content that goes into your course is the same content we teach live in universities, adapted for self-access and grounded in your institutional context rather than a generic one.

What's included

  • Discovery session and policy review
  • One asynchronous course, 45-60 minutes
  • Full white-labelling to your visual identity
  • AI Institutional policy and guidance documents incorporated
  • Interactive knowledge checks throughout
  • Accessibility review
  • SCORM or xAPI package, ready for your LMS
  • Two rounds of amendments
  • 12-month licence, unlimited internal staff users

Typical outcomes

  • Every member of staff reached, not only those who can attend a workshop
  • Your AI policy read and understood rather than filed and forgotten
  • A consistent institutional position on AI, stated in your own words
  • Evidence of completion for governance, audit, and inspection
  • A baseline that live training can then build on

Pricing

£4,995. One course, unlimited staff, 12 months.

No VAT is charged. WorkSmart-AI is not VAT registered, so £4,995 is the total you are invoiced.

That price is deliberate. Most universities require a competitive tender above £5,000, which turns a straightforward purchase into a process measured in months. At £4,995 the decision usually sits with the department, the directorate, or the programme lead who wants the course, and can proceed on a single purchase order.

Renewal is £4,995 a year, which includes policy updates and a content refresh. The licence renews automatically unless you tell us otherwise 30 days before it ends.

Courses you can white-label

Any of our HE workshop content can be built into your own course. The most commonly requested are:

Course

Best for

AI Foundations and Responsible Use

All staff. The usual starting point, and the one most often tied to policy rollout.

AI for Daily Workflows

All staff. Email, meetings, and written communications.

AI for Summarising and Analysing

Professional services and research staff working with documents and data.

Copilot Chat to Copilot 365

All staff moving from Copilot Chat into Microsoft 365 Copilot.

Intermediate to Advanced Copilot

All staff building on Copilot foundations.

Institutions building a full programme usually start with AI Foundations and Responsible Use, then add a second and third course across separate orders once completion data from the first is in hand.

How it works

  1. 1

    Scoping call, 30 minutes.

    We establish what you need the course to do, which staff it is for, and where it will sit.

  2. 2

    You send us your materials.

    Brand assets, your AI policy, your data protection position, any acceptable use guidance, and a named person who can approve the drafts.

  3. 3

    We build, four weeks.

    The four-week clock starts when your materials arrive, not when the order is signed. You get two rounds of amendments inside that window.

  4. 4

    You launch.

    We hand over the SCORM or xAPI package. It goes into your LMS and it is yours to run.

We can deliver in three weeks without customisation, but we do not recommend it. The institutional personalisation is what makes staff recognise the course as theirs rather than as another generic e-learning module, and it is the difference between a course that gets completed and one that gets clicked through.

Licence

You receive a non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use the course internally with your employees for the licence period. WorkSmart-AI retains ownership of the intellectual property, source files, and content. The course cannot be distributed, modified, sold, sublicensed, or made available to third parties without written permission.

The licence renews automatically for further 12-month periods at the current renewal rate, unless either party gives 30 days' written notice.

Common questions

Will it look like ours?

Yes. Your colours, fonts, and logo throughout, with your policies named in the text. Staff should not be able to tell it came from outside the institution.

Can we host it ourselves?

Yes. You get a SCORM or xAPI package for your own LMS. Completion and progress data stays in your systems.

Is there a cap on users?

No. The licence covers every member of staff for the licence period, whether that is 200 people or 20,000.

What if our policy changes?

Minor policy updates are included in the annual renewal. If you expect frequent change, the quarterly policy update service keeps the course current through the year.

Can we edit it ourselves?

Not directly. Amendments come through us, which keeps the content accurate and the accessibility standard intact. Two rounds are included in the build, and further changes can be quoted.

Do you charge VAT?

No. WorkSmart-AI is not VAT registered, so the price you see is the price you are invoiced.

Ready to get started?

Book a free 30-minute scoping call and we will tell you honestly whether a white-labelled course is the right route for your institution, or whether live training would serve you better.
